meta.name: Everyday Japan Diary
meta.description: Everyday Japan diary illustrated with thin textured black pencil outlines. Thursday August 13 is the demo today.

color.palette_type: black pencil art and neutral UI with a blue today marker

accent.role: today illustration, circle and detail date only

neutral.usage: white and soft gray with charcoal ink

color.contrast_strategy: charcoal ink on light neutral backgrounds

typography.font_style_notes: Caveat handwriting across the diary, with larger notes for readability.

spacing.section_rhythm: Top navigation has 32px side insets and a 28px top inset; a 16px gap separates its 44px buttons from the diary card. The illustration keeps its size, with captions and input aligned beneath it.

layout.grid_system: single-column mobile canvas with a seven-column closed calendar
layout.alignment_tendency: strict left edge for content with centred date navigation

shape.border_usage: A thin #BEBEBE gray outline defines the outer app edge. No border or divider around the daily-note input.

motion.entrance_pattern: The connected date strip fades in, centered on the selected date.
motion.exit_pattern: The strip follows horizontal dragging and snaps by exactly one card; fading out returns to the calendar.

components.button_style: Top Home and Filter icon circles with 44px hit targets. Weekday/date return control inside each card. Fixed bottom control with two circular arrow buttons joined by curved waists to a central pencil pill; each button has a 44px hit target.
components.input_style: Borderless transparent daily-note area with no inline pencil, divider or bottom text action. The pencil lives in the fixed controls beneath the card.
components.card_style: White rounded date cards on soft gray paper, joined to neighboring cards by narrow curved bridges; neighboring edges peek in from either side.
components.navigation_pattern: Top Home clears topic filtering and returns to the full month. Filter opens a compact topic panel; choosing a topic keeps calendar dates in place and fades non-matching entries. Weekday/date travels inside each card. Swiping moves the connected card strip; fixed bottom arrows switch dates; the central pencil previews the note’s illustration. Date header, outside click and Escape return to the month view.
components.list_style: seven-column calendar with saved illustration thumbnails and a plus for the blank day
components.component_notes: Thirteen sample entries through Thursday, August 13. Today has a blue illustration and blue circle, with no extra date badge. Only today’s artwork is blue; other dates stay black even when opened. Friday onward stays empty. Artwork uses thin pencil strokes with transparent interiors.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: a small illustrated diary of everyday life in Japan

visual_language.whitespace_usage: large quiet fields around a concentrated drawing

composition.balance_type: asymmetric illustration inside a symmetric device
composition.flow_direction: top navigation to illustration to entry
composition.negative_space_role: protects the illustration and keeps vivid colour from becoming chaotic

imagery.illustration_style: generated thin black pencil outlines with subtle graphite grain along strokes only; all interiors transparent
imagery.graphic_elements: coffee cup, bento, exercise, commuter train, umbrella, laundry and shrine
imagery.pattern_usage: pencil grain within narrow strokes, no shading or hatching
imagery.image_shape: transparent square illustrations contained without cropping

interaction_feel.feedback_style: notes change independently; only the sketch action updates the illustrated result
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: The connected bottom control keeps one continuous white surface. Hover feedback moves the arrow icons slightly and lifts, tilts and enlarges the pencil icon subtly, without separate fill patches. Reduced motion and disabled actions keep the icons still.
interaction_feel.loading_style: complete static drawing with no draw-on animation

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: invite a small daily moment: coffee, lunch, exercise or a walk

overview.fallback_strategy: static prepared demo art and reduced-motion transitions

background_effects.description: Single soft gray background across all days.

image_effects.description: Thin generated pencil strokes with variable alpha. Every non-stroke pixel and object interior is transparent.

visual_effects.composite_notes: No filled illustration interiors or grayscale washes. Only today’s illustrations use blue pencil strokes; all other dates stay black in both calendar and detail views.
